name: fredo
description: Fredo mission control — streams OpenCode telemetry into the Fredo desktop app via OpenTelemetry (OTLP/gRPC :4317 and OTLP/HTTP :4318). Exposes a native MCP server with 27 tools: Kubernetes, Jira, Azure DevOps, Optimizely, observability queries, code execution, and Fredo UI interactions.
